claims.cytotoxic_mechanism: At 2.5 uM, Ro-19-4605 is expected to be largely inactive because its annotated GABA-A benzodiazepine-site inverse agonist mechanism is not cytotoxic and no other plausible cytotoxic off-target is evident.
